title: Discover company info across core home sections and reach About then Contact
description: Verifies a visitor can browse the home sections, navigate to the About page, and then reach Contact to find contact channels successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the hero section
Scroll to the services section
Scroll to the recent news section
Scroll to the partners section
Click the link to view the About page
Click the link to view the Contact page
Verify contact information and a WhatsApp contact number are displayed

title: Administrator can log in and reach the dashboard
description: Verifies an administrator can authenticate from the login page and is redirected to the admin dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the admin dashboard

title: Admin login required to access the dashboard
description: Verifies that a public visitor attempting to access the admin dashboard is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /panel-pab/dashboard
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Direct access to dashboard is gated by authentication
description: Verifies that an unauthenticated user navigating directly to the admin dashboard is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /panel-pab/dashboard
Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Admin can edit content and see it reflected on the public site
description: Verifies an admin can open a content editor, save changes successfully, and see the updated content appear on the home page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click a content area to open its editor
Fill Updated content {{RUN_ID}} into a primary editable text field
Save changes
Click the link to return to the public site home page
Verify the updated content Updated content {{RUN_ID}} is visible on the home page

title: Browse to News from home and see an archive list
description: Verifies a visitor can navigate from the home page to the News page and see a list of news items with category and publication date information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the News page
Verify a list of news items is displayed
Verify news items show category and publication date information

title: Submit a contact message successfully
description: Verifies a visitor can submit the contact form with valid details and see a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill Test User into the name field
Fill test.user@example.com into the email field
Fill This is an automated test message to the company. into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a submission success confirmation is visible

title: Admin dashboard summary is visible after login
description: Verifies that after logging in, the dashboard displays its summary/analytics content to the administrator.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify dashboard summary information is displayed

title: Browse news archive list with metadata
description: Verifies a visitor can open the News page and see an archive list where items include category and publication date information.

steps.description: Navigate to /news
Verify a list of news items is displayed
Verify news items show category and publication date information

title: Contact page displays stored contact channels including WhatsApp
description: Verifies the Contact page shows the company’s contact details and also displays a WhatsApp contact number.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Verify phone, email, and address contact details are displayed
Verify a WhatsApp contact number is displayed

title: Browse to Career and see job information
description: Verifies a job seeker can open the Career page and view career listings or job information content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the Career page
Verify career listings or job information content is displayed

title: Admin can see available content areas to edit
description: Verifies that the dashboard exposes navigable content areas/editors that an admin can choose for updates.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify a list of content areas or editors is displayed

title: View company profile details on About page
description: Verifies a visitor can open the About page and see core company profile information sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the About page
Verify company history, vision, mission, and team profile information are displayed

title: Invalid administrator credentials are rejected
description: Verifies that submitting invalid admin credentials shows an error and does not grant access to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid-user@example.com into the email field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page

title: Contact form required-field validation prevents submission
description: Verifies that submitting the contact form with a required field missing shows a validation error and does not complete submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill Test User into the name field
Fill test.user@example.com into the email field
Fill an empty value into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
